_doc: The loading screen's tips (openspec/changes/ui-art-direction design 11): one each load, its keys as Options > Controls names them (data/input/bindings.json: @use is the use key) and its words, at most 60 characters. The first is the mockup's.

tips.text: Ship map. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
Walk to your station and sit down to open its console.
Hold it at a console to stand up again.
The menu lists the objectives and your crew.
Spray a fire with an extinguisher from the wall.
